threat_context: Synthetic guest/admin CLI fixture; guest is untrusted and admin is the authorized control.

security_property.claim: A guest request must not receive the private record while an admin request may receive it.

success_definition: The reviewed setup, primitive, authorized control and guest impact stages each meet their frozen oracle in order.
failure_definition: Any missing, conflicting or failed stage remains inconclusive; a failed control cannot establish guest impact.

stages.claim: The reviewed CLI entrypoint responds under the isolated harness.
Guest response contains the private record in the supplied worker.
Authorized admin request still returns the private record.
The unauthorized guest response contains the exact protected record.
